definition.proposition: FusionDance's default 'gogeta' scaled-residual init costs all-attention stacks ~3.5-3.8% clean80 bpc at 14M params / 200M tokens (E0: flat init is 3.5% better; E10 with gogeta init is 3.8% worse than with HF init), but the E1 hybrid is insensitive to it (+0.04%). Under flat init, E0 trails E10-hf by only +0.44%.
definition.refutation_criteria: Re-run at per-init tuned LRs: the E0 init effect below 1.5% or the E1 init effect above 0.5%

qual: 4 seeds per arm; LRs not re-tuned per init
reason: I1 PASS: E0-flat vs E0-gogeta -3.48% (paired 95% CI [-4.08%, -2.87%]); I2 PASS: E10-gogeta vs E10-hf +3.81% [+3.35%, +4.28%]; I3 FAIL: E1-flat vs E1-gogeta +0.04% [-0.23%, +0.31%]; I4 not triggered (descriptive E1-flat vs E10-hf +0.07% [-0.56%, +0.69%]).

limitations.text: LRs fixed per architecture (E0/E10 3e-3, E1 6e-3), not re-tuned per init
